chatbot_distribution_tooltip:
Sequential: Distributes services in a rotating manner among eligible agents, following a predefined order. Each new service is directed to the next agent in the sequence (A → B → C → A…). Ideal for ensuring that all agents receive a balanced amount of work over time.

By load: Distributes services based on each agent's current workload. The system checks how many open services each agent has and directs the new service to whoever has fewer pending services or lower work "weight". This option helps maintain a more balanced and efficient distribution, avoiding overload on some agents while others remain idle.

Random: Distributes services completely randomly among eligible agents. It's a simple option to implement, but can result in less balanced distributions, with some agents receiving more services by chance while others receive fewer. May generate large variations in workload among agents.
